def forward(self, x, t, c):
        h = torch.cat([x, c, sinusoidal(t)], dim=1)
        x1_pred = self.out(self.blocks(self.inp(h)))
        denom = (1 - t.reshape(-1, 1)).clamp(min=0.05)
        return (x1_pred - x) / denom
